description: The plot illustrates training loss trajectories over optimization iterations for six model configurations, shown as colored lines with light shaded bands around each curve. The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 140,000 with regularly spaced tick labels at 20,000-iteration intervals. The y-axis is labeled “Loss,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 with tick labels at 0.1 increments. The “Vanilla” series is a purple solid line that drops steeply from about 3.4 near iteration 0 to roughly 2.7 by around 10,000 iterations, then continues a gradual decline to about 2.45 by 140,000. “StrmLLM (n=64)” is a blue solid line that decreases quickly from about 3.4 at the start to around 2.8 by ~20,000 iterations, then declines more slowly to approximately 2.62 by 140,000. “SepLLM (n=64)” is an orange solid line that falls from about 3.4 near iteration 0 to around 2.7 by ~10,000, then trends downward to roughly 2.52 at 140,000. “SepLLM (n=64, H)” is a green solid line with a similar shape, dropping from about 3.4 at the start to around 2.7 by ~10,000 and reaching about 2.51 by 140,000. “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” is a red solid line that declines from about 3.4 initially to around 2.68 by ~10,000 and then gradually decreases to about 2.50 by 140,000. “SepLLM (n=128)” is a darker blue solid line that drops from about 3.4 near iteration 0 to around 2.66 by ~10,000 and continues down to approximately 2.48 by 140,000. A thin vertical green line is drawn at iteration 0, and the legend appears in the upper-right of the plotting area.
caption_used: (a) Training loss trajectories across iterations for various model configurations. The line plot depicts the change in loss over training iterations, with the x-axis labeled "#Iteration" (0 to 140,000) and the y-axis labeled "Loss" (2.4 to 3.4). Six model configurations are compared: Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and SepLLM (n=128). The Vanilla model (purple) exhibits the highest initial loss, declining sharply to approximately 2.7 by 10,000 iterations and gradually stabilizing near 2.45. StrmLLM (n=64) (blue) demonstrates a more rapid initial decline, reaching 2.6 by 20,000 iterations, but ultimately plateaus at roughly 2.75, consistently exceeding the loss of all other configurations beyond 40,000 iterations. SepLLM (n=64) (orange) and SepLLM (n=64, H) (green) follow nearly identical trajectories, with losses converging around 2.52 and 2.51, respectively, though SepLLM (n=64) initially declines at a marginally slower rate. SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red) stabilizes prematurely, maintaining a loss of approximately 2.65 after 60,000 iterations, indicating diminished optimization efficiency. SepLLM (n=128) (blue-violet) achieves the lowest final loss, descending to 2.48, and exhibits the most consistent downward trend, with minimal fluctuations. A vertical green line at iteration 0 demarcates the onset of training. The legend is positioned in the top-right corner.
